facts.big: I was walking when I heard...
facts.label: Past progressive para o contexto
facts.sub: Use was/were + verbo-ing para a cena de fundo e o passado simples para o fato que aconteceu, ligando as duas partes com when.

facts.label: O contexto
facts.sub: Use was/were + -ing para dar o contexto: I was walking here. A kitten was sitting under a car. Isso mostra o que estava acontecendo quando algo mudou.

facts.label: O fato
facts.sub: Depois, use o passado simples para o fato principal: I heard a strange sound. I picked it up. Use when para ligar: I was walking when I heard it.

compare.ask: I was walking when I heard a sound.
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “eu vinha andando quando ouvi um barulho”, com o imperfeito.
compare.tip: Diga: “I was walking when I heard a sound.”
compare.us: Em inglês: was/were + -ing para o contexto, e o passado simples para o evento depois de when.

paragraphs: It is a warm afternoon on a quiet street in Austin. Tall trees give some shade on the sidewalk. Blake waits at his front door and looks at his watch. His friend Marco finally turns the corner. He is carrying something inside his jacket. Blake wants to know the reason.
